**Finding: deviation (§ 12.4, p0051)** — redline validated and submitted.

- **Why it fails the fallback:** the covenant is one-sided against us, runs 18 months from termination, covers *any* person employed by Vendor at any time during the term rather than personnel involved in the Services, prohibits "engaging" (a no-hire), and contains no general-advertising or unsolicited-approach carve-out. The no-hire plus all-personnel scope is walk-away territory, and it contradicts § 12.3, where Vendor acknowledges we made no no-hire commitment.
- **Redline (fallback level, per redline guidance and the Harbor Consulting precedent):** mutual, limited to personnel directly involved in the Services, 12 months from the end of that involvement, no-hire deleted, and general-advertising/unsolicited-approach carve-outs added.
